title: RoboDx: Repair and Diagnosis of Faults in Robot Software
abstract: arXiv:2611.23816v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A patch to a robot's navigation software can pass every unit test and still drive the robot off its path. Checking how the repaired robot drives catches such patches. It does not show that the agent found everything that was wrong. We introduce RoboDx, a generator of repair tasks for simulated robot navigation software with known injected faults. A hidden verifier marks a repair as verified only if the robot then drives correctly in hidden scenarios, which the agent never sees. A second track hides the code and asks the agent to pick the cause from a list of hypotheses. A task with two faults can contain a quiet fault, a fault that makes no hidden scenario fail unless the other fault is also present. On our set of 100 tasks, RoboDx-Hard-100, almost every repair by Claude Opus 5.5 with standard coding tools is verified. We analyse 94 of the tasks, 44 with one fault and 50 with two. translated_title: RoboDx：机器人软件故障的修复与诊断
translated_abstract: 针对机器人导航软件的一个补丁可以通过所有单元测试，却仍然会使机器人偏离其行驶路径。检查修复后的机器人如何行驶可以捕获这类补丁，但这并不能表明智能体发现了所有的问题。我们提出了RoboDx，一个针对模拟机器人导航软件的修复任务生成器，其中注入了已知的故障。一个隐藏的验证器只有在机器人在智能体从未见过的隐藏场景中正确行驶后，才将修复标记为已通过验证。第二条测试轨道隐藏代码，要求智能体从假设列表中选择故障原因。包含两个故障的任务可能包含一个“静默故障”——即除非另一个故障同时存在，否则不会导致任何隐藏场景失败的故障。在我们包含100个任务的集合RoboDx-Hard-100上，使用标准编码工具的Claude Opus 5.5所做的修复几乎全部通过了验证。我们分析了其中94个任务，其中44个为单故障任务，50个为双故障任务。在50个双故障任务中，Opus的49个通过验证的修复中仅有17个……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 提出了RoboDx——一个带有注入故障与隐藏场景验证的机器人导航软件修复与诊断任务基准，实验表明即使修复通过验证，智能体在双故障任务中往往只发现并修复了部分故障（尤其是静默故障）。
en_tdlr: RoboDx is a benchmark generator of injected-fault repair and diagnosis tasks for simulated robot navigation software with hidden-scenario verification, revealing that even verified repairs often miss quiet co-occurring faults.
